title: Four election petitions filed before Madras High Court challenging CM Vijay’s Perambur win
description: Four election petitions have been filed in the Madras High Court challenging Tamil Nadu Chief Minister and Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK) founder C Joseph Vijay’s election from the Perambur Assembly constituency.Two of the petitions has been filed by Vijay’s rival candidates, DMK leaders RD Shekar (Perambur) and Indigo Irudayaraj (Trichy East).
